## IExtractOptions.messageCallback property

Callback invoked for each message during extraction.

**Signature:**

```typescript
messageCallback?: (message: ExtractorMessage) => void;
```

## Remarks

This allows real-time processing of messages as they're emitted, which can be useful for logging, progress tracking, or custom handling.
